paras: Every [[thursday|Thursday]], Leo visits the school [[library|library]]. It is quieter than his classroom, so he can think clearly.
Leo is a careful [[student|student]]. He returns one [[book|book]] and looks for another about the night sky.
His science [[teacher|teacher]] is there too. She offers to [[help|help]] him find a simple guide to the stars.
zh: 每个星期四，利奥都会去学校图书馆。那里比教室安静，所以他能更清楚地思考。
利奥是个认真的学生。他归还一本书，又去寻找一本关于夜空的书。
他的科学老师也在那里。她主动帮他找一本简单的星空指南。

q.s: Leo visits the library every Thursday.
q.why: The first sentence states this directly.

q.s: He wants a book about cooking.
q.why: He looks for a book about the night sky.

q.s: The teacher has written the guide herself.
q.why: The passage does not name the guide's author.
